The bundle attaches one global, `VM`, with a namespace per concern. Each source file adds one function (a few add two or three that belong together) and nothing here has hidden state beyond what's noted -- the theme functions read CSS at call time, the self-installing UI modules keep track of what they've enhanced.

| Namespace | What's in it | Depends on |
|---|---|---|
| [`VM.expressions`](expressions.qmd) | typed formulas → JavaScript functions and numbers, never throwing | math.js (passed in) |
| [`VM.numerical`](numerical.qmd) | Euler and RK4 steppers, Simpson's rule, a Lagrange parabola, L1/L2/polynomial fits | -- (`polynomialFit` takes math.js) |
| [`VM.sampling`](sampling.qmd) | seeded uniform and Gaussian generators | -- |
| [`VM.filters`](filters.qmd) | moving average, EMA, scalar Kalman | -- |
| [`VM.distributions`](distributions.qmd) | 16 closed-form PDFs/PMFs, `logGamma`, `sampleCurve`, `histogramBins` | -- |
| [`VM.plotting`](plotting.qmd) | the theme (`colors`, `layout`, `plotOptions`, …), theme detection, the Plotly patch, fullscreen helpers | Plotly for the patch; otherwise none |
| [`VM.ui`](ui.qmd) | legend overlay, results table, example presets, slider playback | `renderTable` needs htl's `html` |
| [`VM.discreteMath`](discrete-math.qmd) | triangulations and Sperner colorings | -- |

## Conventions

These hold across the whole surface, so each page states only its exceptions.

**Bad input gives `null`, not an exception.** Anything that parses reader-typed text (`makeFunction`, `makeNumber`, `makeRational`) returns `null` when it can't; a fit with too few points returns `null`. Branch on it and draw an [`emptyState`](plotting.qmd#emptyState).

**Outside a distribution's support you get `0`.** Never `NaN`, so a slider at an invalid parameter flattens a curve rather than breaking the chart.

**math.js is passed in, not imported.** `VM.expressions.*` and `polynomialFit` take the math.js instance as their first argument -- the global `math` on a page rendered through the extension. The one exception is `makeRational`, which parses literals only and takes no instance.

**Colors are read when you ask, not when the page loads.** `colors()`, `alpha()` and the three `discreteMath` color helpers return whatever the active theme says right now. Call them inside the cell that builds the traces, and make that cell depend on `vmTheme` so it re-runs on a toggle -- see [`onThemeChange`](plotting.qmd#onThemeChange).

**Self-installing modules take no call.** The Plotly patch, slider playback, the draggable legend, the SVG fullscreen button and the slider-track fill all find their markup themselves. What each looks for, and how to opt out, is in the [markup contract](../markup.qmd).

## Where the signatures live

Every function's JSDoc in `src/js/<category>/<name>.js` is the authoritative signature; these pages restate it with context and a live example. A test (`src/docs-coverage.test.js`) fails the build if a `VM.*` member exists without a heading here, or vice versa, so the two can't drift.
